# My Neuro Health Ltd

My Neuro Health is the trading identity of My Neuro Health Ltd, a UK company preparing adult ADHD assessment and treatment, alongside a separate child assessment service. The website provides pre-launch information and a register-interest route. Appointments are not yet open.

## Adult assessment and treatment
The planned pathway includes pre-assessment information, clinical assessment, feedback and written documentation. Diagnosis is not guaranteed. The planned adult treatment service covers suitability consultations, medication initiation, titration and ongoing care where appropriate. Treatment depends on individual clinical assessment and preference; a prescription is not guaranteed. Availability, eligibility and fees are to be confirmed before bookings open.

## Titration and ongoing care
The proposed service includes follow-up during treatment adjustment and clear ongoing-care arrangements. There is no guaranteed fixed titration duration. GP shared care requires agreement and is not guaranteed. Clinical consultation fees and medication costs will be explained separately before booking. No NHS contract, prescribing availability or regulatory registration is implied by this pre-launch information.

## Children
The child assessment service is in development. Adult prescribing information must not be interpreted as a child medication offer. Age-specific service arrangements will be confirmed separately.

## Enquiries and privacy
The contact form opens an email draft in the visitor's own email app. It is not a secure clinical intake portal and is not an appointment booking system. No detailed medical records should be submitted through this public route. An opened email draft is not a confirmed lead or a paid patient.
